end_dead_sub: The fog closed in. Somewhere down the line the engine kept hissing for a while, and then it didn't.
end_derail_sub: The engine hit the fallen tree at speed and left the rails. Greyhaven never heard the whistle.
end_stranded_sub: The fire went out and the fog came close. Something between the trees stopped pretending to be a tree.
end_win_sub: The bell of Greyhaven rang until dawn. You told them about the 7:10, the notes in the trees, and the tall thing that waits for you to blink. They believed you — the trees around Greyhaven had started falling too.
end_win_letter: A woman on the platform asked about M. You gave her the letter.
m_start: Somewhere on the Ashford line. Greyhaven lies %.1f km ahead.
note_engine_body:
To whoever wakes up next —

She still has fire in her. Shovel coal into the firebox, wait for the steam needle to climb, let off the brake and open the regulator.

Greyhaven is down the line, east. Tell them what happened to the 7:10 from Ashford.

Don't stay off the train for long. If you see the tall one with the paper face, LOOK AT IT. It only moves when you look away.

The whistle hurts it.

— M.
note_carriage_body:
7:10 Ashford – Greyhaven. 23 aboard.

9:40  stopped. Tree across the line.
9:52  driver and fireman went out with the axe.
10:05  the whistle stopped.

People kept getting off to look for them. Nobody came back.
I am the last one awake. I am going to try the engine myself.

— M.
note_shack_body:
It stood by the window all night.
Every time I blinked it was closer.

I stared until morning. My eyes burned.
It was still there when the light came, just standing, like a coat on a hook.

I'm going to run for the line.
note_hut_body:
Third tree down on the Ashford line this month. No wind. No rot.
The trunks are snapped clean at the bottom, like something wants the trains to stop.

Left my winter coal in the hut. If you need it, take it.
note_wreck_title: on the back of a ticket
note_wreck_body:
This carriage never made it.
Somebody wrote on every seat: DON'T LOOK BACK.

But you have to look back. That's the trick of it.
It can't move while you're watching.
note_signalbox_body:
Line closed since the 3rd.
Signals set to danger at every fallen tree.

The tall one comes to the box at night and stands under the lamp. It doesn't like the engines, I think. The noise of them.

Stove coal is in the corner. Greyhaven is a little over two kilometres on.
note_notetree_body:
i looked away

it was smiling

the whistle hurts it

keep the fire lit

it counts us

don't look back.   LOOK BACK.

greyhaven  greyhaven  greyhaven
note_barn_title: a letter tucked in a coal sack
note_barn_body:
M. —

I kept the coal dry for you, like I promised.
If I hear the whistle tonight I'll know you made it through.
The lamps at Greyhaven will be lit.

— your sister, Ada
note_ruin_body:
Whoever finds this:
the thing in the woods is patient, not fast.

Walk backwards if you must, but keep your eyes on it.
It hates the engine's scream.
note_post_body:
DON'T LOOK AWAY

(someone has added underneath, in pencil:)
unless you're running
